statement: In the PORTFOLIO-DEMO-01 WORK_ORDER (GOLDEN_HASH_POLICY, STOP_CONDITIONS), result_sha256 was UNKNOWN_AT_C1 and was to be required equal across two independent equivalent runs and then frozen in tests/test_examples_demo.py; a cross-run result_sha256 mismatch was a STOP condition.
title: PORTFOLIO-DEMO-01 original result_sha256 policy (C1)
